name: Typecheck after TypeScript changes
oneLine: Runs tsc --noEmit in the background after Claude edits TypeScript, so type errors surface even when tests don't cover the file.
description: Gates on .ts/.tsx edits and runs a project-wide tsc --noEmit asynchronously. Project-wide because cross-file type errors are the ones that matter, async because tsc is too slow to run inline on every edit. One caveat: rapid edit sequences can overlap runs; on huge codebases consider gating to Stop instead.
scriptBody:
#!/bin/bash
# typecheck-after-ts: background tsc --noEmit on TS edits (async).
set -u
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" || exit 0
[ -f tsconfig.json ] || exit 0
if ! npx tsc --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "TypeScript errors after editing $file:" >&2
  npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
installSteps: Save the script to .claude/hooks/typecheck-after-ts.sh and chmod +x it.
Add the config fragment to .claude/settings.json (async: true included).
testSteps: Positive: have Claude introduce a type error in one file that breaks another - the async hook should report it.
Negative: edit a .js or .py file - tsc should not run.
verifiedAgainst: Claude Code hooks reference, event/matcher schema checked 2026-09-10
seoTitle: Typecheck after TypeScript changes - Claude Code hook
seoDescription: An async PostToolUse hook that runs tsc --noEmit after TypeScript edits.
